name: Pilot b2 — Mathematical Equations, 5/5/5

currentCoverage.note: node scripts/audit-bank.mjs, 3 September 2026, against the 45 active b1 items
currentCoverage.observation: b1 tied letter count to tier exactly and every low item asked the root letter at depth 1. Four documented equation shapes and the star topology are absent entirely.

overrepresented: letter count as a proxy for difficulty
pure chain topology (0 of 127 multi-variable systems were stars)
low tier answered in one step from a pinned root
gaps: two unknowns equal to a constant `A + C = 8` (Ex 3)
multiple multiplicative terms `2 x A + 2 x C = B` (Ex 3)
compound coefficient plus offset `3 x C - 1 = B` (Ex 6)
combining equations spanning a subset of the letters (Ex 6 leaves B out)

allowed: integer letter values in 1..20 with exactly one solution per letter
chain, star and mixed definition topologies
two unknowns equal to a constant
combining equations over all letters or a subset
review: the one-letter/four-option question format (flagged unconfirmed in the section guide)
forbidden: quadratic or higher-power terms, including a letter multiplied by a letter
non-integer, zero or negative letter values
an inverted-operation note blaming an operator the system does not contain
a level-2 hint quoting an equation containing only the asked letter

difficultyModel.metric: measured substitution depth to the asked letter; a combining-equation collapse costs one move per definition pushed into it
difficultyModel.high: depth >= 3, and the asked letter must not be the first determined
difficultyModel.note: letter count is drawn independently of tier; the generator measures every letter's depth and asks one inside the band

structuralConstraints.fingerprint: tier | sorted equation skeleton with numerals blanked | topology | depth | asked-letter position

seedStrategy: seed = SHA-256(generator, section, tier, batchId, index, attempt); one independent stream per slot

expectedDistribution.high: 5 items at depth >= 3, expecting combining equations and at least one star topology
expectedDistribution.shapes: the pilot should demonstrate at least three of the six previously-unreachable structures
